summary: Registrant AGNC Investment Corp. filed an 8-K to announce a new at-the-market (ATM) common stock issuance program for up to $2 billion. The filing is a routine current report disclosing entry into sales agreements with multiple agents; it does not involve a transformative special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The company may sell shares from time to time on a best-efforts basis, with up to 1.0% compensation per agent. This is an ordinary capital markets activity, not a special-situation event.
